theme: An open calendar over a full day of family logistics.
greeting: The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete, and nothing sits on the calendar today. The shape of the day is the passport morning behind you and the Croatia countdown ahead — the booking window closes when you sail on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the girls' Disney tickets
needsAttention.detail: The Orlando villa and rooms are handled, so tickets for your six are the hard wall now — the p1 is due today. Check whether your ticket type needs park reservations.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Sept 19 Cavtat hotel and transfers
needsAttention.detail: One night in Cavtat after the charter, plus the Komolac transfer and a 5:15 AM airport run — this has to be booked from dry land before you sail on the 8th. Book refundable.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows 0 checked bags; verify the allowance on the Eurowings Discover site with the record locator and buy bags now, before airport-counter rates. Two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20–22 St Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday the 20th and the girls aren't picked up until Tuesday the 22nd — two nights in the St Pete area still unbooked before the Orlando villa starts.

schedule.title: Passport appointments — all four girls
schedule.detail: Gateway Mall post office, new books, ~1 hour

flagged.title: Nautilus sailing — final payment due
flagged.detail: QuickBooks flagged invoice #2170 unpaid, balance $6,475 — the final Croatia course payment.

flagged.title: Five caregiver applicants on Care.com
flagged.detail: New applications to your childcare posting came in overnight from five candidates.

flagged.title: Liberty Mutual home policy renewal
flagged.detail: Renewal notice arrived — worth a glance before it auto-renews.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters — NYT Cooking, the Midcoast Villager — plus a LinkedIn accept and promos.

resolved.title: Sailing course materials shipped
resolved.detail: Nautilus sent the textbooks with tracking on Aug 25, and instructor Paul introduced himself to the crew today ahead of the Sept 12 course.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: Late summer's tomatoes, cucumbers, and herbs are at their peak, so a composed salad lets them carry the plate.

tasks.title: Hedge the Sept 20 car — refundable Full Size SUV backup unless Mike's car is confirmed en route
Call the dermatologist to book the wart-removal appt (stack into the phone sitting)
Buy EU (Type F) plug adapters and a US power strip before Sept 8

acts.line: The 9:30 passport appointment for all four girls, then the phone sitting to stack alongside it — pediatrician, cell plan, and the dermatologist call.
No meetings anywhere on the calendar — a rare open stretch in the middle of a heavy travel-planning week.
A quiet St. Pete evening with the girls; the garden and a composed summer salad are waiting.
